commander.speaker: doctor
commander.text: Mander, you hear me?

commander.speaker: commander
commander.text: Yes, ma'am. Although I was enjoying the silence.

commander.speaker: doctor
commander.text: Cute. Try not to die. Running low on medical supplies, and we still have people out there to find.

commander.speaker: commander
commander.text: Any sign of them?

commander.speaker: doctor
commander.text: Nothing yet. And the ship's still missing parts. We're not going anywhere until we find what we need.

commander.speaker: overseer
commander.text: Environment... unscanned. Exploration... not advised.

commander.speaker: commander
commander.text: Oh, great. The floating Christmas ornament has concerns.

commander.speaker: overseer
commander.text: Human mortality rate... explanation found. Poor judgment.

doctor.speaker: commander
doctor.text: Doc, how's it looking out there?

doctor.speaker: doctor
doctor.text: Cold, hostile, and biologically fascinating. So, basically, my dream vacation.

doctor.speaker: commander
doctor.text: Keep your eyes open for our people. Any sign of them, you call it in.

doctor.speaker: doctor
doctor.text: Mander, I know. Missing crew, missing ship parts, questionable survival odds. I've got the list.

doctor.speaker: overseer
doctor.text: Enthusiasm detected. Caution... absent.

doctor.speaker: doctor
doctor.text: Oh, shut up. I literally brought you back to life.

onComplete.codexSummary: Locate missing crewmates and salvage replacement ship parts across the thawing crater while investigating the anomalous environment.

conversations.title: Scene 02 — The Planet Is Waking Up

default.speaker: doctor
default.text: Wait. Those things... they're actually growing as we speak.

default.speaker: overseer
default.text: Growth detected... impossible. Region frozen... until recently. Anomaly confirmed.

default.speaker: commander
default.text: Well, somebody forgot to tell the plants.

default.speaker: doctor
default.text: No, seriously. Something changed here. And I want to know what.

default.speaker: overseer
default.text: Cause... unknown. Investigation... not advised.

default.speaker: doctor
default.text: And being mysterious instead of being helpful is frequently annoying.

commander.speaker: commander
commander.text: Contact! We've got movement!

commander.speaker: overseer
commander.text: Hostile lifeform detected. Threat level... critical. Caution advised.

commander.speaker: doctor
commander.text: Wait, wait, I want to see how it reacts—

commander.speaker: commander
commander.text: Doc, it's trying to kill me!

commander.speaker: doctor
commander.text: Well, that's one reaction.

doctor.speaker: commander
doctor.text: Doc, you've got movement!

doctor.speaker: overseer
doctor.text: Hostile lifeform detected. Threat level... critical. Caution advised.

doctor.speaker: doctor
doctor.text: Wait, wait, I want to see how it reacts—

doctor.speaker: commander
doctor.text: Doc! It's coming right at you!

doctor.speaker: doctor
doctor.text: Well, that's one reaction.

commander.speaker: doctor
commander.text: Interesting. There's liquid water here. I want a sample.

commander.speaker: commander
commander.text: Uh, can you make sure it doesn't dissolve my boots first?

commander.speaker: overseer
commander.text: Liquid composition... unknown. Sample analysis... required.

commander.speaker: doctor
commander.text: Finally. Something we agree on.

commander.speaker: commander
commander.text: You two agreeing on something is somehow more disturbing than the water.

doctor.speaker: doctor
doctor.text: Interesting. There's liquid water here. I want a sample.

doctor.speaker: commander
doctor.text: Doc, maybe check if that stuff dissolves your boots first?

doctor.speaker: overseer
doctor.text: Liquid composition... unknown. Sample analysis... required.

doctor.speaker: doctor
doctor.text: Finally. Something we agree on.

doctor.speaker: commander
doctor.text: You two agreeing on something is somehow more disturbing than the water.

commander.speaker: doctor
commander.text: You just ripped that thing open?!

commander.speaker: commander
commander.text: There was something inside.

commander.speaker: doctor
commander.text: That's not an answer! What if it's an egg?

commander.speaker: commander
commander.text: Then congratulations. We just became parents.

commander.speaker: overseer
commander.text: Parenthood... not advised. Survival odds... already questionable.

commander.speaker: doctor
commander.text: Oh my God.

doctor.speaker: commander
doctor.text: Doc, did you seriously just rip that thing open?

doctor.speaker: doctor
doctor.text: Okay... why the fuck did I just open that?

doctor.speaker: commander
doctor.text: I was about to ask you the same thing.

commander.speaker: doctor
commander.text: Hold on. That one's different. Its biology's... completely wrong.

commander.speaker: overseer
commander.text: Biological mutation... detected. Origin... unknown.

commander.speaker: commander
commander.text: Perfect. An upgraded nightmare. Just what we needed.

doctor.speaker: doctor
doctor.text: Hold on. That one's different. Its biology's... completely wrong.

doctor.speaker: overseer
doctor.text: Biological mutation... detected. Origin... unknown.

doctor.speaker: commander
doctor.text: Doc, admire it later. That thing's dangerous.

commander.speaker: doctor
commander.text: Okay, that was interesting. Something just altered your equipment's output.

commander.speaker: commander
commander.text: I'm choosing to interpret that as a good thing.

commander.speaker: overseer
commander.text: Technology... ours. Effects on human subjects... unknown.

commander.speaker: doctor
commander.text: That's literally how half of science starts.

commander.speaker: overseer
commander.text: Scientific methodology... questionable.

doctor.speaker: doctor
doctor.text: Whoa. Something just changed my equipment's output. That's... interesting.

doctor.speaker: commander
doctor.text: Doc, tell me if that thing didn't just fry your gear.

doctor.speaker: overseer
doctor.text: Technology... ours. Effects on human subjects... unknown.

doctor.speaker: doctor
doctor.text: That's literally how half of science starts.

doctor.speaker: overseer
doctor.text: Scientific methodology... questionable.

commander.speaker: commander
commander.text: Chandy, you recognize this?

commander.speaker: overseer
commander.text: Chandy... invalid designation. Correct: Overseer.

commander.speaker: doctor
commander.text: Tomato, tomato.

commander.speaker: overseer
commander.text: Artifact... recognized. Current condition... unexpected.

commander.speaker: doctor
commander.text: Unexpected how?

commander.speaker: overseer
commander.text: Discrepancy... unexplained. Data insufficient.

commander.speaker: commander
commander.text: First time for everything, Chandy.

doctor.speaker: commander
doctor.text: Chandy, do you recognize what Doc found?

doctor.speaker: overseer
doctor.text: Chandy... invalid designation. Correct: Overseer.

doctor.speaker: doctor
doctor.text: Tomato, tomato.

doctor.speaker: overseer
doctor.text: Artifact... recognized. Current condition... unexpected.

doctor.speaker: doctor
doctor.text: Unexpected how?

doctor.speaker: overseer
doctor.text: Discrepancy... unexplained. Data insufficient.

doctor.speaker: commander
doctor.text: First time for everything, Chandy.

commander.speaker: commander
commander.text: Whoa! What the hell was that?!

commander.speaker: doctor
commander.text: Shit! Was that an earthquake? What the hell caused that?

commander.speaker: overseer
commander.text: Seismic activity detected! Source... unknown!

doctor.speaker: doctor
doctor.text: Shit! Was that an earthquake? What the hell caused that?

doctor.speaker: commander
doctor.text: Doc! You alright? That shake came through the comms!

doctor.speaker: overseer
doctor.text: Seismic activity detected! Source... unknown!

commander.speaker: commander
commander.text: Fuck! Again?! This whole place is coming apart!

commander.speaker: doctor
commander.text: Fuck! That was worse! Something's seriously wrong here!

commander.speaker: overseer
commander.text: Seismic intensity... increasing! Structural instability... critical!

doctor.speaker: doctor
doctor.text: Fuck! That was worse! Something's seriously wrong here!

doctor.speaker: overseer
doctor.text: Seismic intensity... increasing! Structural instability... critical!

default.speaker: overseer
default.text: Four signatures... matched. Memory recovered. Tower concealment.

default.speaker: commander
default.text: You remember something, Chandy?

default.speaker: overseer
default.text: Ship impact damaged tower. Four concealment modules... scattered.

default.speaker: doctor
default.text: Wait. These upgrades? We've been carrying pieces of its security system?

default.speaker: overseer
default.text: Correct. Tower maintains planetary stasis. Alien attempts thaw. Exposed tower... vulnerable.

default.speaker: commander
default.text: So we put its protection back before the Alien interferes again.

default.speaker: overseer
default.text: Affirmative. Components recovered. Activate tower to initiate restoration.

onComplete.codexSummary: All four enhancement modules were scattered components of the Artifact Tower concealment array. Return to the tower to restore planetary stasis protection.

conversations.title: Scene 08 — Why Is Everything Attacking Us?

default.speaker: commander
default.text: Is everything on this planet trying to kill us?

default.speaker: overseer
default.text: Indigenous organisms... high threat.

default.speaker: doctor
default.text: That's an observation, not an explanation.

default.speaker: overseer
default.text: Hostility confirmed. Organisms displaying... hostile behavioral patterns.

default.speaker: doctor
default.text: You just used more words to tell me the exact same thing.

default.speaker: commander
default.text: Doc, I think you're breaking our GPS.

commander.speaker: commander
commander.text: So this is the tower. Chandy, what exactly are we looking at?

commander.speaker: doctor
commander.text: So this is it? Chandy, tell me you actually know what this thing does.

commander.speaker: overseer
commander.text: Structure confirmed. Artifact tower... active. Function... uncertain.

doctor.speaker: commander
doctor.text: Doc, check that structure. Let's see what we're dealing with.

doctor.speaker: doctor
doctor.text: So this is it? Chandy, tell me you actually know what this thing does.

doctor.speaker: overseer
doctor.text: Structure confirmed. Artifact tower... active. Function... uncertain.

default.speaker: overseer
default.text: Tower safeguards... offline. Activation prohibited.

default.speaker: doctor
default.text: Then we need to figure out what broke it.

default.speaker: overseer
default.text: Four modules detected. Activation unlocked.

default.speaker: commander
default.text: Finally. Something that works.

default.speaker: doctor
default.text: Don't celebrate yet. We still don't know what happens when you activate it.

commander.speaker: doctor
commander.text: What the FUCK is that?!

commander.speaker: overseer
commander.text: Massive hostile... detected! Threat level... extreme!

commander.speaker: commander
commander.text: Yeah, I can fucking see that!

commander.speaker: doctor
commander.text: Look at the size of that thing!

commander.speaker: overseer
commander.text: Hostile entity... unexpected! Restoration sequence compromised!

commander.speaker: commander
commander.text: Your scanner picked a hell of a time to fail!

commander.speaker: doctor
commander.text: We can't let that bastard anywhere near the ship!

commander.speaker: commander
commander.text: Then we're taking that thing down!

doctor.speaker: doctor
doctor.text: What the FUCK is that?!

doctor.speaker: overseer
doctor.text: Massive hostile... detected! Threat level... extreme!

doctor.speaker: doctor
doctor.text: Look at the size of that thing!

doctor.speaker: overseer
doctor.text: Hostile entity... unexpected! Restoration sequence compromised!

doctor.speaker: commander
doctor.text: Your scanner picked a hell of a time to fail!

doctor.speaker: commander
doctor.text: Doc, keep that bastard away from the ship! Take it down!

conversations.title: New Event 05 — Concealment Restored & Regional Refreeze

default.speaker: overseer
default.text: Threat neutralized. Concealment restored. Stasis field... reactivated.

default.speaker: doctor
default.text: Mander, look! The ground's freezing again.

default.speaker: commander
default.text: Good. At least one thing we broke is fixed.

default.speaker: commander
default.text: Is it dead?

default.speaker: doctor
default.text: Give me a second. I'm trying to read the biological signals.

default.speaker: doctor
default.text: You know what bothers me? Some of its readings don't make sense.

default.speaker: commander
default.text: Doc, please. Can we have one moment where nothing tries to kill us?

default.speaker: doctor
default.text: Fine. But we're coming back to this.

default.speaker: commander
default.text: Chandy, this thing takes us to another artifact, right?

default.speaker: overseer
default.text: Affirmative. Destination... another location. Same planet.

default.speaker: doctor
default.text: So we're still looking for our people, still missing ship parts, and now we're teleporting into more alien bullshit.

default.speaker: commander
default.text: Pretty much.

default.speaker: overseer
default.text: Remaining here... no benefit. Departure... advised.

default.speaker: doctor
default.text: I hate that he has a point.

default.speaker: doctor
default.text: You know, I'd love to get a sample from one of those creatures back at the ship.

default.speaker: commander
default.text: Absolutely not.

default.speaker: doctor
default.text: I haven't even told you what I want to do with it.

default.speaker: commander
default.text: That's exactly why I said no.

default.speaker: overseer
default.text: Current approach... reckless. Risk... unnecessary.

default.speaker: commander
default.text: Got a better idea?

default.speaker: overseer
default.text: Several.

default.speaker: commander
default.text: Great. Keep them to yourself.

default.speaker: doctor
default.text: I'm actually with the floating chandelier on this one.
